end.summary:
Practised recognising equal parts and naming halves, thirds and quarters.
Identified one-third as one of three equal parts and found one-third of 15 as 5 pencils.
Selected shapes with equal-sized parts for one-third and one-quarter.
Initially described a fraction using parts left or eaten compared with parts remaining; this was not corrected after the last time seen.
end.parentNote: Asha practised fractions as equal shares using rotis, pencils, watermelon, and flags. Nisha correctly used equal groups to identify one-third and recognised that one-third of 15 is 5; they also selected diagrams where all parts were equal. Nisha mixed up the fraction with the parts left or eaten, and this was still present at the last check. At home, share a roti or paper shape into equal parts and ask, “How many equal parts make the whole?” before naming one part.
